• Run small experiments, evaluate the results, and quickly iterate.

The role: What's in the Box

As a Supply Risk Planner, you will support the day-to-day execution of supply risk tracking and operational planning across your assigned ingredient category. You will focus on maintaining key risk databases, tracking supplier commitments, and identifying short-term inventory and supply constraints before they impact customer delivery or menu availability.

Sitting within the Supply Risk & Planning team and reporting  to the Associate Director of Supply Risk & Planning, you will drive routine risk analysis, monitor category metrics, and proactively evaluate emerging supply risks. You will act as a pragmatic problem solver and key operational liaison with Strategic Sourcing, SCO, Demand Planning, and Menu Planning across our EU markets.

What you’ll do: The Recipe

Long-Term Supply Risk & Planning (T-12 to T-52)

• Volume Commitments: Track supplier volume commitments for your category, identifying under- or over-committed volumes, and coordinate with Strategic Sourcing and Menu Planning to execute mitigation steps.

• Menu Planning Constraints: Maintain and update the catalogue of category supply constraints (e.g., SKU volume caps, supplier lead-time limits, minimum recipe frequency requirements) that feed into Menu Planning cycles.

• SKU Portfolio Reviews: Provide accurate data and category analysis for quarterly SKU portfolio reviews, ensuring active SKUs align with business performance and customer requirements.

Mid-Term Supply Risk & Planning (T-0 to T-12 - Menu Planned, Not Yet Live)

• Supply Volume Tracking: Monitor SKU and supplier-level forecast shifts in your category to identify emerging availability risks that require immediate mitigation.

• SKU Risk Database: Maintain the category SKU risk database and follow established risk management protocols. Partner with Strategic Sourcing, SCO, and FSQA to maintain updated risk scores per SKU and engage Menu Planning when demand steering is needed.

• Waste at Risk: Track waste-at-risk projections for your category. When waste projections exceed acceptable limits, engage Demand Planning, SCO, and Menu Planning to initiate corrective actions before menus go live.

• Inventory on Hand: Monitor inventory levels against forecasted demand across fulfillment centers, partnering with SCO and 3PW teams to maintain healthy stock parameters.

• SKU Caps Management: Track the operational impact of SKU caps on recipe options. Where caps overly constrain customer menu variety, discuss with Strategic Sourcing, SCO and Menu Planning to reduce the customer impact.

• Allocation Execution: Support allocation decisions across markets when a known SKU shortage occurs ahead of menu lock-in, following established business allocation logic.

• NID Go-Live Readiness: Perform final operational risk checks with SCO to verify that all approved NIDs within your category are correctly enabled for ordering prior to menu launch.

What you’ll bring: The Ingredients

• 2+ years of experience in supply chain planning, procurement operations, or a related field, backed by a degree in Supply Chain, Business, Economics, or a relevant discipline.

• Data Proficiency: Proficient in working with spreadsheets (Google Sheets) using formulas, lookup functions, and pivot tables to analyze operational datasets.  

• Tooling & AI Usage: Exposure to SQL or BI reporting tools (such as Databricks) is helpful, alongside a strong interest in utilizing AI to streamline analysis and routine tasks.  

• Pragmatic Problem Solving: Hands-on mindset with an ability to break problems down into clear, manageable steps and propose practical solutions.

Voltus is a leading company for Distributed Energy Resources (DERs). Our mission is to be the platform that fulfills the promise of the energy transition. The Voltus platform connects any DER to any energy market across the US and Canada, providing flexibility, reliability, and resilience to the grid while generating revenue for our partners.

We hire teammates who are bright, gritty, and good and who have a genuine passion for delivering a cleaner energy future and for working in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment. We are a remote and virtual company, distributed across US, Canada, and abroad.
The Role
Voltus is hiring for multiple roles at the senior level on several teams. As a Senior Engineer you will find a home on one of these teams and assume a technical leadership role in our backend solutions and front end technologies where appropriate to the team. You'll join a fully remote team tackling complex energy industry challenges, collaborating with experienced engineers on our modern tech stack, and contributing to core systems that decarbonize the grid.
Your work will involve building core backend logic, APIs, designing data pipelines, or creating customer interfaces. A strong candidate can speak to their alignment with our core values of bright, gritty, and good, and you want to work with others like you in a highly collaborative environment.
Technologies We Use
We build scalable software using Python, Postgres, Go, FastAPI, Temporal, Delta Lake, Clickhouse, Typescript, and React, running our services using Docker and the HashiCorp stack on AWS. We do not expect candidates to have a background in every tool listed here; instead, we place a high value on strong foundational programming skills and a genuine eagerness to learn and grow. Responsibilities

• Assume a technical leadership role, with other senior engineers, for the team’s solutions bringing past experiences to improve our coding practices and team principals and operating procedures.

• Represent engineering in close collaboration with our product and design teams and internal stakeholders including technical requirements gathering

• Author and support process and design documentation and exemplify best practices by example

• Work principally in the backend and data handling layers of our technology stack with front end development on occasion

• Minimum of 8 years of experience as a code-contributing engineer

• Multiple years of experience working in one or more of our foundational backend technologies and with databases

• An empathetic individual who cares about engineering culture with demonstrated contributions to team culture and engineering best practices

• A strong collaborator who understands what it means to be a force multiplier

• Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

• Partner with product, data and engineering leads to turn business problems into shipped AI features.

Expert, hands-on Python. 5+ years writing production Python daily: async, typing, packaging, testing (pytest) and performance profiling. You write the code, not just the design doc.

Model serving and optimisation. Practical knowledge of inference servers, GPU utilisation, batching, quantisation and caching to manage latency and cost.

•
RAG and data. Hands-on with embeddings and vector databases (pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant or similar) and building reliable data pipelines.

•
ML fundamentals. Solid understanding of transformers, tokenisation and fine-tuning, with experience using PyTorch and Hugging Face.

•
Engineering discipline. CI/CD, observability, API design and writing software others can maintain.

•
Ownership. Comfortable making architectural calls with incomplete information, explaining trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders, and working without a ready-made playbook.

Nice to have

• Experience as the first or founding AI/ML engineer at a start-up or scale-up.

• Agent frameworks and protocols such as LangGraph, LlamaIndex, DSPy or Model Context Protocol (MCP).

• Distributed training or multi-GPU work (DeepSpeed, FSDP, Ray).

- Du gehst aktiv auf Saloninhaber:innen in deiner Region zu - telefonisch, per Walk-in oder über Social Media (Kaltakquise).

- Du verantwortest deinen eigenen Funnel vom Erstkontakt bis zum Abschluss.

- Deine Woche planst du eigenverantwortlich, mit klaren Zielen und einer Führungskraft, die dich unterstützt und weiterentwickelt.

- Du gibst dein Wissen weiter - im Roleplay, im Shadowing und im Austausch mit Kolleg:innen, die neu dabei sind.

DAS BRINGST DU MIT

- Nachweisbare Erfahrung im B2B-Vertrieb mit eigener Abschlussverantwortung über den gesamten Sales-Cycle hinweg, von der Kaltakquise bis zum Closing.

- Hohe Selbststeuerung und Eigenverantwortung - du gehörst zu den ersten Teammitgliedern vor Ort.

- Du bist es gewohnt, an KPIs gemessen zu werden und hast deine eigenen Zahlen stets im Blick.

- Du schaffst es, ein komplexes Produkt verständlich zu vermitteln und dabei zu begeistern.

- Du bist lernbereit, setzt Feedback um und willst dich weiterentwickeln.

- Du bist sicher im Umgang mit digitalen Tools.

- Verhandlungssicheres bis muttersprachliches Deutsch sowie gute Englischkenntnisse.

- Führerschein der Klasse B und Freude daran, in deiner Region unterwegs zu sein.

DAS ERWARTET DICH BEI UNS

- Klare Entwicklungschancen: Nächste Senioritätsstufen erreichst du mit deiner Performance - simpel gehalten und schnell erreichbar. Außerdem besetzen wir Team-Lead-Rollen bevorzugt aus dem eigenen Team und begleiten den Weg dorthin mit unserer Sales Manager Academy.

- Eine Führungskraft und Kolleg:innen, die dich jederzeit unterstützen.

- Eigenverantwortliche Wochenplanung und Vertrauensarbeitszeit.

- Firmenwagen inkl. Tankkarte sowie MacBook und iPhone.

- 50 € steuerfreies Guthaben pro Monat über Probonio.

- Fixgehalt und ungedeckelte Provision.

- Teamevents, die ihren Namen verdienen: Sommerfest, Winterfeier und regelmäßige Teamformate.

WIE GEHT ES WEITER?

1. Bewerbung & Sichtung - wir melden uns so schnell wie möglich bei dir.

2. Erstgespräch mit unserem Recruiting-Team (ca. 30-45 Minuten).

3. Video-Call mit deiner künftigen Führungskraft.

4. Field Day - zwei Stunden bei uns im Office. Du siehst, wie wir arbeiten, wir sehen dich in Aktion.

5. Abschlussgespräch mit unserer Head of Sales.

title: Global Head of Commercial Claims (Warranty)
description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.
About the role
At Sulzer , we don't just keep industry moving, we help some of the world's most critical sectors operate more efficiently, reliably and sustainably. With a heritage spanning almost 200 years, more than 13,000 employees worldwide and operations serving customers across over 160 countries, Sulzer is a global leader in fluid engineering and services. As we continue to evolve and strengthen our customer-focused aftermarket offering, we are looking for an exceptional leader to build and scale a key global capability.

We are looking for a commercially driven leader to take ownership of Sulzer 's global warranty and claims management strategy, building a world-class function that protects profitability while delivering outstanding customer outcomes. As Global Head of Commercial Claims (Warranty), you will lead the development of a centralised global claims capability, bringing consistency, governance and commercial rigour to a diverse international portfolio of customer claims. What You'll Be Doing

• Lead and develop Sulzer 's global commercial claims strategy and operating model

• Manage, coach and grow a high-performing global team, initially leading two direct reports with expansion planned

• Drive consistent claim assessment, negotiation and settlement approaches across multiple regions and businesses

• Act as the senior escalation point for complex and high-value customer claims

• Partner with Engineering, Quality, Legal, Finance and Commercial teams to deliver robust claim outcomes

• Establish governance, reporting, performance metrics and best-practice processes

• Balance customer satisfaction with commercial, contractual and financial protection

• Influence stakeholders globally, often without direct authority, to drive timely decision-making and resolution

• Create a culture of accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement

• Support the long-term growth and maturity of Sulzer 's Global Centre of Claims Excellence

What We're Looking For
We're less interested in someone who has spent their entire career processing warranty claims and more interested in a commercially astute leader who can build, influence and drive change.
You will likely bring:

• Senior leadership experience within commercial, contracts, claims, dispute resolution, customer operations or similar environments

• Proven experience leading teams and developing people

• Strong commercial acumen with the ability to assess risk, negotiate outcomes and protect business value

• Experience operating in complex matrix organisations and influencing senior stakeholders

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

• A customer-focused mindset balanced with sound business judgement

• The confidence to make decisions in ambiguous and evolving situations

• International experience or a demonstrated ability to operate effectively across global cultures and markets

• Sufficient technical curiosity and understanding to interpret engineering findings and challenge where appropriate, without needing to be the technical expert

Who Will Thrive Here?
This role is ideal for an ambitious leader looking for a genuine step up in scope and impact.
You'll enjoy this opportunity if you:

• Like building rather than maintaining

• Enjoy solving complex business challenges

• Are comfortable operating with ambiguity and creating structure where it doesn't yet exist

• Take ownership and drive outcomes without waiting for direction

• Can balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution

• Enjoy collaborating across different functions, cultures and time zones

• Get energy from influencing change and delivering measurable results

This role is unlikely to suit someone seeking highly defined processes, predictable workflows
